matchups.analysis: ESPNFAN6437471416's sitting pretty at 53% with ESPN projecting 118.9 to Doakes22's 114.2—a 4.7-point cushion that actually means something when you've got nine studs still waiting in the wings (Cook, Chase Brown, Wilson, Skattebo) while Doakes is banking on Jefferson, Bowers, and Watson to all exceed their projections after George Pickens already maxed out the luck budget with 28 points against a 13.2 projection. The problem for Doakes is that you can't build your entire comeback on three guys when two of them are already baked into ESPN's estimate and Brandon Aubrey just cost you 5.8 points by playing like he forgot how kickers work—that's the margin of error you can't afford when you're chasing a lead with your best-case scenario already in the books. ESPNFAN wins if the depth just hits the floor, Doakes only wins if Jefferson and Bowers both decide to go full Pickens mode while you're crossing your fingers that Ollie Gordon doesn't get game-scripted into irrelevance, and that's asking a lot from players who are already supposed to carry you to 114.
